title: Blind navigator · Level 2: Five waypoints
brief: Five waypoints drawn inside the floor, visited in the order listed, then back to the start. tour.json holds them, a JSON list of [x, y] in mm; practice runs without it. Until P0c-2s ships, tour.json is in the arena frame: the start frame's (x, y) is the arena's (x - 300, y - 300) to within the start's 20 mm and 3 degrees; a run scores only if the robot's centre enters a circle of radius 250 mm around each waypoint in the order listed (the return to the start is not one); otherwise it scores 0 and does not finish. Par score 80. Write your own estimate as track.csv after the motors stop: one row t_ms,x_mm,y_mm at least every 500 ms from Run to the program's end (the sensor's own period: the IMU on 8 takes 500 ms to start, so keep your first row as soon as IMU(8) returns), in the start frame (x ahead at the start, y to its left, mm), with an optional fourth column th_deg (your heading estimate, shown as its RMS error, unscored); t_ms must rise row by row. The course compares it with the true position of the robot's centre at each row's t_ms. The level fixes the robot: the class robot with an IMU on I2C 8; its real axle track is drawn for each run near the 178 mm your program assumes (the hidden error). The robot starts within 20 mm and 3 degrees of (300, 300) facing +x. The run ends when the program ends, at 120 s at the latest. Per run: 60 x max(0, 1 - e_end / 200) (e_end: the true end to your true start) + 40 x max(0, 1 - e_track / 100) (e_track: the RMS distance of your estimate from the truth; 0 unless track.csv covers the run with no gap over 500 ms). Pass: a mean of at least 60 over 10 runs, and at least 8 runs that drive the tour, end within 200 mm and write track.csv.

score.run: round(if(visitedInOrder == 5, 60 * max(0, 1 - hypot(endX - startX, endY - startY) / 200) + if(repCovered, 40 * max(0, 1 - repRms_xy / 100), 0), 0), 1)

complete.value: count(r in runs: r.visitedInOrder == 5 & r.repCovered & hypot(r.endX - r.startX, r.endY - r.startY) <= 200)
